# ProgressCircle

Circular usage gauge for compact dashboards; like Progress it colours itself by thresholds (black < 75 % ≤ orange < 90 % ≤ red).

`KenosUI.ProgressCircle` · Homelab

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.ProgressCircle value={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.ProgressCircle" value="{{0}}"></x-import>
```
